description: Config-as-code dependency automation. Scoped AWAY from deploy/k8s/**: those manifests are owned by Flux ImageUpdateAutomation, and bot commits touching them would replay incident #9 (CI <-> image-automation loop). Code-dependency bumps elsewhere legitimately mint image builds via the ci.yaml images path filter.

packageRules.description: Automerge patch updates via GitHub native auto-merge (requires repo setting 'Allow auto-merge').
